faces.name: Kolodin, Triumph Caster
faces.oracleText:
Mounts and Vehicles you control have haste.
Whenever a Mount you control enters, it becomes saddled until end of turn.
Whenever a Vehicle you control enters, it becomes an artifact creature until end of turn.

faces.name: Koloth, Tribble Hunter
faces.oracleText:
At the beginning of your end step, each player creates two 1/1 white Tribble creature tokens with "This token can't block."
All Tribbles get +1/+0 and are goaded. (They attack each combat if able and attack a player other than you if able.)
